events.text: The overview: the latest satellite pass, what needs doing, and your fields
Every clear Sentinel-2 pass is read; the date of the latest one is at the top
Press a tile to pick out those fields in the list on the right
The weather for the farm, and whether rain is coming
Fields: every field on the satellite map, tinted by its condition
A field's readings: water, plant health, stress and harvest readiness
Plant health this season against the normal years, 2019 to 2021
Data: the field's record since 2019, against the farm and the normal years
Hover or use the arrow keys for a month's numbers
Plant health or water, month by month
Downloads: field outlines, satellite passes, monthly history and the season report
Tell us what happened: what it was, which field, when, and a picture
Send: the words stay on screen while it is saved
The report opens the assistant with the field and the photo
It stays with the chat, beside the farm's readings and weather
The assistant answers from the farm's own readings, history and weather
A saved conversation: how a field did this season, and what to watch
Settings: the farm's name and place, its fields and their crops
Set a crop: pick what you sowed; until then the detected crop is used
Add a field: click its corners on the satellite map
The new field is saved and analysed at once
Remove a field: confirm, and its readings go with it
Units: hectares, acres or mu, everywhere in the app
Change farm: search a village, paste coordinates, or draw your land
The map flies there; the fields are found around the pin
Pick the fields that are yours, then save
The farm is saved and analysed; come back after each satellite pass
